about: The app API specification: recorded from the Python host in demo mode (2026-09-21), maintained by hand since the Python conversation was retired (marvin-contracts/README.md).
volatile: times (t, ts, id, since, uptime, ages, durations)
brain state values (seated_s, still_s, distance_m, breath_rate, heart_rate, targets, expression, status, detail, mood)
the room sensors' readings (state.room: the simulated room's values and ages)
background tasks: ids, times, what they spent, and the model's description (size, capabilities, how it thinks: think_chat and think_tasks are false or a level name)
the Senses screen (get/senses.json): the scene, the devices, the voice's state and the ears' diagnostics, the last answer and look are live values (the Java host only)
machine_dependent: get/voice_options.json: Ollama models, speech backends and voices installed on the machine that recorded it; compare the shape only

pending.about: Endpoints frozen by the Marvin v1 plan (contracts C2-C4, 2026-10-14) and not implemented yet: their goldens are the specification. The stream that implements one moves it to 'get' in the same commit, so the contract test replays it.
